display_name: Awareness E12: Visitor and tailgater (full episode)
description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional architecture practice, you first play the red team: in a courier's hi-vis you try to talk the front desk into buzzing you through a badge door. Then you swap seats onto reception and handle the visitors yourself. Only the reception seat is scored, and checking or reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
